name: sword_fern
source: hand-authored fixture — PNW ground cover. Reauthored 2026-05-18 — orb + ground_hug instead of scatter_7 fronds (which spider-webbed at scale).

interactions.examine: A sword fern. Fronds arched out from a low crown, deep green, leathery. New fiddleheads coiled at the center. {lex:scent} clings to the underside.
interactions.pickup: You uproot a frond. It breaks at the rachis with a wet snap.
interactions.kick: The fronds part around your boot and spring back.
